Gộp hiện vật

The controlled consolidation of multiple build artifacts or packages from different sources into a single distributable or deployable unit for integration testing or release.

Definition

The controlled consolidation of multiple build artifacts or packages from different sources into a single distributable or deployable unit for integration testing or release.

Operational example

An artifact merge combines outputs from multiple build jobs, creating a comprehensive package for system integration testing.
